The EBITDA for 2025 was CHF 2,064.7 million. To calculate the share of EBITDA relative to net sales, we use the formula:

$$
\text{EBITDA Margin} = \frac{\text{EBITDA}}{\text{Net Sales}} \times 100
$$

$$
\text{EBITDA Margin} = \frac{2,064.7}{11,201.3} \times 100 \approx 18.4\%
$$

Thus, the EBITDA share of Sika's 2025 net sales of CHF 11,201.3 million was approximately 18.4% [doc_id p.5].
